moat_source: AWS switching costs and scale, Prime ecosystem lock-in, logistics network no competitor can replicate; evidence: AWS accelerating to +28% at a $150B run-rate fifteen years into the franchise

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: capex normalization timing (when the $200B investment year converts to FCF)
primary_model_risk: FCF trough depth and duration: 2026 FCF is deliberately crushed by the $200B capex plan. Base case assumes capex peaks in 2026 and FCF ramps to ~$135B by 2030; if AI infrastructure demand disappoints, the same spend becomes stranded depreciation and the bear case's shallower FCF recovery governs. The whole valuation is a bet on the conversion timeline.
expectations_gap_key_variable: capex conversion: at 31x trailing earnings with FCF suppressed, the market prices a successful conversion of the $200B into durable AWS/AI cash flows; our base case agrees directionally but discounts a slower ramp - the ~18% gap is timing, not thesis
top_5_bull_arguments: AWS at +28% and accelerating on a $150B run-rate - reacceleration at this scale is extraordinary
Q2 guided above consensus on both revenue and operating income
In-house silicon (Trainium) improves AWS unit economics as AI workloads scale
Advertising keeps mixing earnings toward high margin regardless of the capex cycle
If conversion lands (bull case), ~$175B of 2030 FCF at 28x supports ~$313 - meaningful upside from $250
top_5_bear_arguments: $200B capex is the largest corporate bet ever made; overbuild risk is real and 2026 FCF is already sacrificed
Expected IV ($213) sits ~15% below the price - the AWS acceleration is already paid for
Microsoft and Google are spending comparably; trench warfare in AI cloud compresses everyone's returns
Antitrust attention on retail and cloud is persistent and unpriced
A consumer downturn hits retail margins exactly when capex needs funding
thesis_breakers: 2027 capex guided above 2026's $200B (no normalization in sight)
Q2 2026 actuals below $190B revenue or $19B operating income
AI-capacity utilization disclosures suggesting overbuild (price cuts, delayed data-center openings)
position_size_recommendation: 0-2%; fair-value zone - accumulate on capex-fear drawdowns toward expected IV (~$213)
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Revenue/AWS/guidance/capex are reported or management-stated; the FCF path (the decisive input) is constructed around the disclosed $200B capex plan - confidence_level medium.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +6.47% past week, trailing P/E 31.21, analyst average target $312.91 (pass1). No verified historical multiple range captured.
